hook: Most developers overlook this one test — and it leads to bugs in production.
main_idea: Always test your AI agents with edge cases to prevent unexpected behavior.

scenes.title: Run Tests Regularly
scenes.caption: Make it part of your workflow.

voiceover: Most developers overlook this one test... and it leads to bugs in production. Edge cases are crucial when testing AI agents. They help you catch unexpected behavior before it goes live. Here's a simple test you can implement today... First, check how your agent responds to an empty string. It should return a default response. Next, test it with unknown inputs... make sure it handles errors gracefully. Don't forget to check valid inputs too! Finally, test how it reacts to None. Run these tests regularly... and you'll improve your AI agent's reliability. Start testing today to prevent those frustrating bugs!
captions: Make it part of your workflow.
